notes: NEW NAVIGATION. The page drop-down is gone: soundLAB now has app-style section tabs — Learn, Guitar, Keys, Play and Practice — in the top bar on computers and along the bottom of the screen on phones and iPad portrait. Pages inside a section are the pills under the top bar (Guitar: Neck, Tab, Notation; Keys: Piano, Synth, Pads; Practice: Woodshed, Trainer, Tuner). THE METRONOME IS NOW A CORNER ICON: tap it (top right) to open the metronome over whatever you're doing; close it with the X, Esc or a tap outside and it keeps clicking — the icon glows and pulses on the beat while it runs. Its sounds and tempo trainer fold away under their own headings. The Scale menu is grouped: everyday scales first (major, natural minor, pentatonics, blues), then the minor family, the modes and exotic scales. NOTE: this update is live on web/desktop/PWA immediately; the Android APK build lags until the next PC build.
